neighbours.label: 'K'/'k' paired with a preceding J/j (j/k, J.K., jk, ijk)
fire: Honestly I hate pineapple on pizza... j/k, I ordered two last night.
My favourite actor is J.K. Simmons, especially in Whiplash.
You failed the exam? jk jk, you got an A, relax.
Fans lined up for hours to meet J.K. Rowling at the book signing.
Sure, I'll clean the whole house tomorrow, J/K lol.
The memo was signed by J.K. Galbraith in 1958.
for (i, j, k) in itertools.product(range(3), repeat=3):
quiet: Honestly I hate pineapple on pizza, so I ordered pasta last night instead.
My favourite actor is Jeff Bridges, especially in The Big Lebowski.
You failed the exam? No way, you got an A, relax.
Fans lined up for hours to meet the author at the book signing.
Sure, I'll clean the whole house tomorrow, if it rains.
The memo was signed by the ambassador in 1958.

notes: Card: ' j' x6, 'ij', 'jk', 'JK', '.K' x2, ',k'; probe: 'j/k' 0.76, 'J.K.' 0.45, loop index j 0.22. Near misses use J or K separately.
